label: YouTube Storytelling
description: Creator-led stories and vlogs; character, context and an earned payoff with a rhythm that breathes.
intent: Tell a story that unfolds through concrete events and meaningful reactions.
avoid: forced cuts during an emotional reaction
generic stock clips unrelated to events
opening: Introduce a truthful compelling situation and what is at stake.
editing: Progress from situation to complication to reaction to consequence; let the payoff breathe. Borrow cinema grammar selectively: point-of-view and reaction pairs, motivated sound bridges, purposeful close-ups and silence, without sacrificing click-promise clarity or authentic chronology.
typography: Concise place/time labels or emphasis, not constant captions unless asked.
sound: Music changes with story tension; retain authentic live sound and breaths.
critique: Would a viewer understand who wants what and why the moment matters? Whose perspective does the viewer occupy, and does each reveal change understanding rather than merely refresh the screen?

creative_contrast.when: A new idea, action or visual fact arrives
The viewer needs to read, understand or feel something
